title: Entrywise nonnegativity of the inverse relative gain array in dimension six
summary: We prove that $(G\circ G^{-1})^{-1}$ is entrywise nonnegative for every real symmetric positive definite matrix $G$ of order at most six. Its entries are strictly positive exactly within the connected components of the nonzero-entry graph of $G$. An explicit rational example of order seven establishes sharpness. We give two complementary structural proofs. The analytic proof combines a trace obstruction with continuation of positive column forms and a bordering identity. The algebraic proof establishes a stronger four-dimensional polarized inequality through an explicit ten-square polynomial…
